column3: ## Enter an article with multiple authors and multiple affiliations

Go to the "Enter Article Metadata" tab in the "Publisher Area"

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//publisher/metadata
In "Article Title" textbox enter "Study on Open Access Impact"
Select an Online ISSN from the dropdown
In Authors section, for the first author enter Name "Author 1", Affiliations "University of Oxford; Harvard University", and ORCID iD "https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789"
For the second author enter Name "Author 2", Affiliations "MIT; Stanford University; Cambridge University", and ORCID iD "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3456-7890"

column4: At the top of the page confirmation message "Article created/updated" is shown

column3: Navigate to the Table of Contents for the journal or search for the created article

column4: Under "Author 1", "University of Oxford" and "Harvard University" are displayed on separate lines
Under "Author 2", "MIT", "Stanford University", and "Cambridge University" are displayed on separate lines
